class.name: NetwRequest
class.brief_description: Something a peer asked the server for, which the server can deny.

method.name: deny
method.description: Refuses the request and records [param reason] and [param code] for the peer that asked. Only the first call counts. A [param code] of [constant @GlobalScope.OK] is an error and denies nothing.

members.member: The code [method deny] was given, or [constant @GlobalScope.OK] while the request is not denied.
The reason [method deny] was given, empty while the request is not denied.
